name: The Isle
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The open-world dinosaur survival game, Evrima. Installs the dedicated server with SteamCMD and keeps it updated.
startup: if [ -z "{{EOS_CLIENT_ID}}" ] || [ -z "{{EOS_CLIENT_SECRET}}" ]; then echo "The Isle needs its dedicated server Epic Online Services client ID and secret (from the game's server hosting guide). Set them in Startup, then start the server again."; exit 1; fi; if [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = 1 ]; then ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /home/container +login anonymous +app_update {{SRCDS_APPID}} ${SRCDS_BETAID:+-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID"} ${SRCDS_BETAPASS:+-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS"} $([ "{{VALIDATE}}" = 1 ] && echo validate) +quit || echo "Steam couldn't update the game, so the server starts as it is."; fi; exec ./TheIsle/Binaries/Linux/TheIsleServer-Linux-Shipping -Port={{SERVER_PORT}} -log "-ini:Engine:[EpicOnlineServices]:DedicatedServerClientId={{EOS_CLIENT_ID}}" "-ini:Engine:[EpicOnlineServices]:DedicatedServerClientSecret={{EOS_CLIENT_SECRET}}"

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# The Isle. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 412680) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously.
# Game.ini, the admins and saves are never replaced.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-412680}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)
chmod +x TheIsle/Binaries/Linux/TheIsleServer-Linux-Shipping
# Without steam_appid.txt next to the server binary (its working folder),
# Steam's server API fails to start.
echo 412680 > TheIsle/Binaries/Linux/steam_appid.txt
# The server reads Game.ini. One is written when there's none; the Panel sets
# the name, players, passwords, RCON, queue and game options in it at every
# start, and the rest (admins, whitelist) is yours.
ini=TheIsle/Saved/Config/LinuxServer/Game.ini
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$ini")"
if [ ! -f "$ini" ]; then
    cat > "$ini" <<'EOF'
[/Script/TheIsle.TIGameSession]
ServerName=An Isle server
MaxPlayerCount=100
MapName=Gateway
bEnableHumans=false
bQueueEnabled=false
QueuePort=10000
bServerPassword=false
ServerPassword=
bRconEnabled=false
RconPassword=
RconPort=8888
bServerDynamicWeather=true
bAllowReplay=true
Discord=

[/Script/TheIsle.TIGameStateBase]
AdminsSteamIDs=
EOF
    echo "Made Game.ini."
fi
for key in ServerName MaxPlayerCount bEnableHumans bQueueEnabled QueuePort bServerPassword ServerPassword bRconEnabled RconPassword RconPort bServerDynamicWeather bAllowReplay Discord; do
    grep -q "^$key=" "$ini" || sed -i "/^\[\/Script\/TheIsle.TIGameSession\]/a $key=" "$ini"
done
echo "Installed The Isle build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once.

variables.name: Password on
variables.description: true makes players join with the server password.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: The password players join with when Password on is true.

variables.name: Humans
variables.description: true lets players play as humans.

variables.name: Dynamic weather
variables.description: true turns on changing weather.

variables.name: Replay
variables.description: true lets players replay as a new dinosaur after dying.

variables.name: Discord
variables.description: The invite code of your Discord server, shown to players, or empty for none.

variables.name: Queue
variables.description: true queues players when the server is full; give the queue port an allocation.

variables.name: Queue port
variables.description: The port the join queue uses; give it an allocation.

variables.name: RCON
variables.description: true turns on remote admin tools (RCON).

variables.name: RCON password
variables.description: The password for remote admin tools (RCON).

variables.name: RCON port
variables.description: The port remote admin tools (RCON) connect to; give it an allocation.

variables.name: EOS client ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Epic Online Services client ID, from The Isle's server hosting guide. The server won't start without it.

variables.name: EOS client secret
variables.description: The dedicated server's Epic Online Services client secret, from The Isle's server hosting guide. The server won't start without it.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Validate files
variables.description: Check every game file against Steam when installing or updating, which repairs damaged files but takes longer.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam branch to install: evrima, the current game. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
